description: Summarize a caller-supplied agent tool-call trace: per-tool call, error, duration, and token statistics, the list of failed calls, and trace totals. Local computation only; nothing is recorded or fetched.

events.description: Tool-call events to summarize, in trace order

error.description: Error message for a failed call (optional)

input_tokens.description: Input tokens consumed by the call (optional)

output_tokens.description: Output tokens produced by the call (optional)

started_at_ms.description: Call start time in milliseconds (any epoch the caller chooses; only differences are used)

tool.description: Name of the tool that was called

name: summarize_trace
